projects.title: VASARA: Autonomous Robotic Venous Anastomosis for Rapid Microvascular Trauma Vessel Repair Using Reinforcement Learning and Sim-to-Real Transfer​​
projects.description: Developed VASARA (Autonomous Robotic Venous Anastomosis for Rapid Microvascular Trauma Vessel Repair), an autonomous microsurgical robotic system leveraging reinforcement learning and sim-to-real transfer for precise vascular suturing. Built a custom CoreXY robotic platform with closed-loop vision and trained policies in simulation before deploying to physical hardware for sub-millimeter autonomous vessel repair tasks. Recognized with top placements at major science and engineering competitions.

projects.title: Upregulated phosphorylation in Alzheimer’s disease links excitotoxicity of NMDA receptors and impaired long-term potentiation
projects.description: Co-authored a research abstract linking Alzheimer's disease to inhibited long-term potentiation using differential gene expression data.

projects.title: Utilizing Deep Learning to Forecast Humanitarian Crises Through Media Coverage Patterns
projects.description: This project develops a deep learning model that analyzes global news coverage to identify media-driven patterns associated with emerging crises. A custom large language model was fine-tuned using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation), allowing the system to process historical news data efficiently and recognize trends associated with humanitarian emergencies.

projects.title: PhysioRise: An Application Utilizing Machine Learning to Guide Users Through Effective Warm-Up Sessions to Avoid Sports-Related Injuries
projects.description: Our application aims to utilize Artificial Intelligence to generate a personalized warm-up routine tailored to individual fitness levels, goals, and limitations, and Apple’s Machine Learning action classification for users to receive real-time feedback during warm-up exercises, ensuring correct form and technique.
